title: 第531章 无法煮熟羊的锅
slug: 规则怪谈从诡异哆啦a梦开始

第(1/3)页

那道声音林远再熟悉不过了。

当然，红太狼也很熟悉。

因为每当懒羊羊或者其他小羊被抓住的时候，这只羊总能在他们快要吃到嘴里的时候出现。

它就是——喜羊羊。

不过除了喜羊羊以外，林远还听到了美羊羊的声音。

“灰太狼，你快放了懒羊羊和沸羊羊，是村长让我们来的！”

“如果你不放的话，喜羊羊就要用村长的一大利炮炸掉狼堡了！”

美羊羊似乎抢过了喜羊羊手里的喇叭，嗔怒地喊了起来。

林远听到这话，瞬间愣住。

“老婆，这一大利炮，是什么东西？”

一大利炮，听着就像热武器啊。

而且原作中，似乎也没有这种武器。

红太狼思索了一下，对着林远说道：

“灰太狼，这可能是慢羊羊杀死其他青青草原动物，获得的东西。”

“也可能是他新研制出来的......”

“不过灰太狼，你想吃羊吗？”

林远下意识地转过了头，看向站在他身旁的红太狼。

杀死青青草原动物，获得的东西......那是不是意味着，慢羊羊藤蔓上的头，就是小灰灰的？

而这样看来，红太狼明显是知道什么的。

所以小灰灰已经死了？

可为什么龙国的提示和沸羊羊的说法里，都看到了小灰灰？

并且昨天吃青蛙的时候，红太狼也拿了一些肉说要喂给小灰灰。

这到底是怎么一回事？

还有为何在这生死危机时，红太狼第一时间想的不是让灰太狼去赶走或抓来喜羊羊和美羊羊呢。

而是......你想吃羊吗？

回答想或者不想，有什么区别吗？

可惜，林远没有命去赌。

“老婆，你想吃我们今天就吃，就算等会什么一大利炮给我炸死了，我也要让老婆吃到羊！”

林远抓起了昏迷的懒羊羊，放在了头顶。

“据我所知，懒羊羊在睡着的时候，是无敌的状态。”

“我可以趁着这个机会，挡下喜羊羊的攻击，老婆你趁着这段时间给沸羊羊煮了。”

红太狼目不转睛地盯着林远，脸上摇摆不定起来。

最终，在她叹了几口气后，对着林远说道：

“灰太狼，我们今天不吃羊。”

“你出去佯装投降，然后故意失误，让喜羊羊和美羊羊救走懒羊羊与沸羊羊吧。”

林远脖子都震惊到前倾了。

这是红太狼能做出的决定吗？

虽然小羊死后，慢羊羊会诡异化屠杀除羊村以外的所有羊。

但这么好的机会，红太狼居然不决定吃羊？

“红红，你到底有什么瞒着我？”

林远举起懒羊羊，抬眼问道。

That voice was all too familiar to Lin Yuan.

Of course, Red Wolf is also very familiar.

Because whenever Lazy Sheep or other lambs are caught, this sheep will always appear when they are about to eat it.

It is - Pleasant Goat.

But besides Pleasant Goat, Lin Yuan also heard the voice of Beautiful Goat.

"Big Big Wolf, hurry up and let the lazy sheep and boiling sheep go. The village chief asked us to come!"

"If you don't let go, Pleasant Goat will use the village chief's big cannon to blow up the Wolf Castle!"

Beautiful Goat seemed to have snatched the horn from Pleasant Goat's hand and shouted angrily.

When Lin Yuan heard this, he was stunned for a moment.

"Honey, what is this big cannon?"

A big cannon, it sounds like a hot weapon.

And there seems to be no such weapon in the original work.

Red Wolf thought for a moment and said to Lin Yuan:

"Big Big Wolf, this may be something Slow Sheep obtained by killing other green grassland animals."

"Maybe it's something he newly developed..."

"But Big Big Wolf, do you want to eat sheep?"

Lin Yuan subconsciously turned his head and looked at the red wolf standing next to him.

What you get from killing the animals in the green grassland...Does that mean that the head on the slow sheep vine is Xiao Huihui's?

And from this point of view, Red Wolf obviously knows something.

So Xiao Huihui is dead?

But why did Xiao Huihui appear in both Long Guo's reminder and Fei Yangyang's statement?

And when eating frogs yesterday, Red Wolf also took some meat and said he wanted to feed it to Xiao Huihui.

What is going on?

And why, in this life-and-death crisis, Red Wolf's first thought was not to let Gray Wolf drive away or capture Pleasant Goat and Beautiful Goat.

But... do you want to eat sheep?

Does it make any difference if you answer yes or no?

It's a pity that Lin Yuan has no life to gamble.

"Wife, if you want to eat it, we can eat it today. Even if a big cannon blows up and kills me later, I will let my wife eat the sheep!"

Lin Yuan grabbed the unconscious Lazy Sheep and placed it on top of his head.

"As far as I know, Lazy Sheep is invincible when sleeping."

"I can take this opportunity to block Pleasant Goat's attack. Wife, you can use this time to cook for Boiling Goat."

Red Wolf stared at Lin Yuan intently, his face wavering.

Finally, after she sighed a few times, she said to Lin Yuan:

"Big Big Wolf, we won't eat sheep today."

"You go out and pretend to surrender, then make a mistake on purpose and let Pleasant Goat and Beautiful Goat rescue Lazy Goat and Boiling Goat."

Lin Yuan's neck was so shocked that he leaned forward.

Is this a decision that Red Wolf can make?

Although the lamb dies, the slow sheep will strangely slaughter all the sheep except Yangcun.

But with such a good opportunity, Red Wolf didn’t decide to eat the sheep?

"Honghong, what are you hiding from me?"

Lin Yuan raised Lazy Sheep and raised his eyes and asked.

Red Wolf smiled apologetically and said:
